# Mermaid

> Mermaid is a JavaScript-based diagramming and charting tool that generates diagrams from Markdown-inspired text definitions. It renders text into SVG diagrams dynamically in the browser or via CLI.

Mermaid lets developers and non-developers alike create, edit, and share diagrams using a simple text-based syntax. It integrates natively into Markdown documents on GitHub, GitLab, and many other platforms.

## Supported Diagram Types

- **Flowchart** – Directed graphs with nodes and edges; supports subgraphs, styling, and multiple layout directions (TB, LR, RL, BT).
- **Sequence Diagram** – Models interactions between participants over time using message arrows, loops, alternatives, and notes.
- **Class Diagram** – UML class diagrams with classes, attributes, methods, and relationships (inheritance, composition, aggregation).
- **State Diagram** – Finite state machines with states, transitions, forks, joins, and nested states.
- **Entity Relationship Diagram** – ER diagrams showing entities and their relationships (one-to-one, one-to-many, many-to-many).
- **User Journey** – Maps the steps a user takes to complete a task and scores the experience at each step.
- **Gantt Chart** – Project timelines with tasks, durations, milestones, and section groupings.
- **Pie Chart** – Simple pie charts with labeled slices and optional title.
- **Quadrant Chart** – 2D quadrant plots for categorizing items along two axes.
- **Requirement Diagram** – Documents requirements, their types, risks, and relationships to design elements.
- **Gitgraph (Git Flow)** – Visualizes Git branch and commit history with checkout, commit, merge, and cherry-pick operations.
- **C4 Diagram** – Architecture diagrams at the system context, container, component, and code levels.
- **Mindmap** – Hierarchical radial mind maps from indented text.
- **Timeline** – Chronological timelines with dated events grouped into sections.
- **Sankey Diagram** – Flow diagrams showing the magnitude of flows between nodes.
- **XY Chart** – Bar and line charts plotted on numeric X/Y axes.
- **Block Diagram** – Flexible block-based diagrams with composite blocks and edges.
- **Packet Diagram** – Network protocol packet layouts with bit-level field definitions.
- **Architecture Diagram** – System architecture overviews with services, groups, and connections.

## Key Features

- Text-to-diagram rendering using a Markdown-like DSL
- SVG output rendered directly in the browser
- Supports theming (default, dark, forest, neutral, base) and custom CSS
- Live online editor at [mermaid.live](https://mermaid.live)
- CLI tool (`@mermaid-js/mermaid-cli`) for server-side PNG/SVG/PDF generation
- Security: sandboxed iframe rendering mode for untrusted input
- Widely integrated into GitHub, GitLab, Notion, Confluence, VS Code, and many other tools

## Integration

Mermaid diagrams are written inside fenced code blocks tagged with `mermaid`:

````markdown
```mermaid
flowchart LR
    A[Start] --> B{Decision}
    B -- Yes --> C[Action]
    B -- No --> D[End]
```
````
